summary: Frontend visual-regression testing after the Earthy-Green redesign + dark mode migration. Verified login, theme toggle (light/dark persistence), dashboard charts, all 12 sidebar pages, Members/Contributions dialogs, Reports pie+bar charts, status badges, Malayalam rendering, mobile responsiveness, and logout. No functional regressions detected; all 14 routes render in both modes without console errors. Two minor UX observations reported as feedback for the main agent.

issues: Joining Date field uses browser-native <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component. Picker UI looks inconsistent with the rest of the redesigned theme (especially in dark mode the OS picker renders with default browser chrome).
Status field uses native <select> instead of the shadcn <Select> component. The dropdown options popup uses OS-native styling that breaks the Organic & Earthy theme consistency.

Recharts emits repeated warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render. Charts ultimately render fine, but this is caused by ResponsiveContainer measuring before parent flex layout settles. Consider setting an explicit min-height (e.g. min-h-[300px]) on the chart wrappers.

positive_verifications: Login: hero image (left) + form (right) layout renders correctly; admin login works and redirects to /dashboard.
Theme toggle (data-testid='theme-toggle-btn'): toggles 'dark' class on <html>, persists across page navigation AND across full page reload (verified both directions).
Dashboard: stats cards visible, Monthly Collections bar chart bars render in BOTH light and dark mode (green bars confirmed visually).

All 12 sidebar pages render without console errors or blank screens in dark mode: /members, /contributions, /benefits, /medical-aid, /death-assistance, /financials, /committee, /meetings, /reports, /notifications, /audit, /users.
Members table: renders 102+ Malayalam script names (e.g., കിരൺ, കൃഷ്ണ, ഇല്ല്യാസ്) without clipping.
Add Member dialog: opens, uses bg-card so it adapts to theme, form fields readable.
Reports page: pie chart (2 sectors) AND bar chart (8 bars) both render visibly in dark mode using hsl(var(--chart-N)) tokens.
Status badges (badge-paid, badge-pending): readable in both modes — paid uses primary green tint, pending uses amber tint with good contrast.
Logout: AUTH.logoutButton in sidebar clears session and redirects to /login.
Mobile (390x844): hamburger (data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle') opens sidebar overlay with all menu items visible (verified visually via screenshot).
action_items: [Low/UX polish] Replace native <input type='date'> in Members Add/Edit dialog with shadcn Calendar+Popover.
[Low/UX polish] Replace native <select> for Status field with shadcn Select component.
[Low] Add min-height to Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers to silence width/height(-1) warnings on initial render.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme persistence works correctly via next-themes (attribute='class', stored in localStorage).

All page-level migrations to semantic tokens (bg-card, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, bg-primary) successful — no leftover hardcoded stone-*/green-* classes blocking dark mode rendering on any of the 14 pages tested.
Layout.jsx correctly uses resolvedTheme from useTheme() for the toggle icon swap (Sun/Moon) — no SSR hydration issues observed.
Native HTML form controls (date input, select) in Members.jsx dialog do not pick up shadcn theme tokens; recommend migrating to shadcn equivalents for visual consistency.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required flows pass; only minor design polish items remain)

seed_data_creation: None. No test records were created — existing migrated data was used read-only as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual redesign is functionally complete and stable. If revisiting: only outstanding items are (1) replacing native date/select inputs in Members dialog with shadcn variants, and (2) silencing Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings via min-h on chart containers. Backend was not touched in this iteration — last backend test in iteration_5 passed 19/19.
